title: README's first verify command fails on a fresh clone — suite requires a prior --import to register class_names
evidence:
README.md:32-33:
godot --headless -s res://tests/run_tests.gd    # epic test contracts (exit 0 = pass)
godot --headless --import                       # import gate

Verified on a pristine copy of this worktree (no .godot/): `godot --headless -s res://tests/run_tests.gd` → "SCRIPT ERROR: Parse Error: Identifier \"Geodesic\" not declared in the current scope. at: GDScript::reload (res://tests/test_gesture.gd:46)" ×many, "FAIL res://tests/test_geodesic.gd — script failed to load/instantiate" (all 5 scripts), "SUITE RESULT: FAIL (5 failure(s))", exit 1. After `godot --headless --import` first: "SUITE RESULT: PASS (0 failure(s))", exit 0. The dev worktree contains .godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg, which masks this locally.
detail: The suite loads scripts before the global class cache exists, so the README's documented first command fails entirely on a clean checkout. The spec's own Verification section lists --import first; README reverses the order.
recommended_fix: Reorder README to run `godot --headless --import` before the suite (matching the spec's Verification order), or note the import dependency in the command comment.

title: tests/test_gesture.gd.uid exists in the worktree but is absent from the diff — the only script whose .uid isn't committed
evidence: git status --porcelain in this worktree: "?? tests/test_gesture.gd.uid". The diff ships 17 .gd.uid files (scripts/capture_runner.gd.uid … tests/test_base.gd.uid, tests/test_camera.gd.uid, tests/test_geodesic.gd.uid, tests/test_input.gd.uid, tests/test_no_sim.gd.uid) — grep -c 'test_gesture.gd.uid' over the canonical diff.patch returns 0. Worktree file content: "uid://jqk1tdawwie1".
detail: The project commits a .uid beside every script (17 in this diff); the new r1-fix test script's uid file was generated but never staged. Fresh clones regenerate a different uid, leaving the tree inconsistent.
recommended_fix: git add tests/test_gesture.gd.uid (uid://jqk1tdawwie1) before pushing so all 18 scripts ship their uid.

title: captures/*.png.import left untracked while icon.svg.import is committed
evidence: git status --porcelain in this worktree: "?? captures/01-globe-biomes.png.import", "?? captures/02-district.png.import", "?? captures/03-arc-connected.png.import", "?? captures/04-parallel-bundle.png.import". The diff instead commits "diff --git a/icon.svg.import b/icon.svg.import" (new file).
detail: The project's convention (evidenced by icon.svg.import in this diff) is to commit Godot import metadata; the four capture .import files sit untracked and uncovered by .gitignore, leaving dirty-tree noise.
recommended_fix: Either `git add captures/*.png.import` to match the icon convention, or add a .gitignore rule for captures/*.import.

title: Orthonormal-basis-from-direction helper duplicated between node_site.gd and pipe_arc.gd
evidence:
scripts/node_site.gd:39-41:
	var helper := Vector3.UP if absf(n.dot(Vector3.UP)) < 0.99 else Vector3.RIGHT
	var t1 := n.cross(helper).normalized()
	var t2 := t1.cross(n).normalized() # right-handed: det(t1, n, t2) = +1

scripts/pipe_arc.gd:118-120:
		var helper := Vector3.UP if absf(dir.dot(Vector3.UP)) < 0.99 else Vector3.RIGHT
		var t1 := dir.cross(helper).normalized()
		var t2 := t1.cross(dir).normalized() # right-handed: det(t1, dir, t2) = +1
detail: Identical degenerate-safe basis construction (helper pick + double cross) is copy-pasted in two production scripts; a fix to one (e.g. epsilon or handedness) would silently miss the other.
recommended_fix: Extract a shared static helper (e.g. Geodesic.orthonormal_basis(dir)) and use it from both _orient_to_surface and _rebuild_trestles.

title: Closest-arc pair search duplicated between capture_runner._readable_pair and test_gesture._pair_with_arc with a magic 0.65
detail: The same O(n²) nearest-to-target-arc pair loop exists twice (capture harness hardcodes 0.65; the test parameterizes it), so tuning the readable-span constant can drift between captures and tests.
recommended_fix: Share one parameterized pair-search helper (e.g. a Geodesic or WorldSeed static taking target arc) used by both capture_runner and test_gesture.
